package.name: vda5050_bridge
package.description: Subscribes to VDA 5050 order/instantActions over MQTT and drives Nav2; publishes VDA 5050 state/visualization/connection back. See adapters/vda5050_amr/README.md and ros2_bridge/README.md. This is the ROS 2 half of the split described in CLAUDE.md section 4.5 -- the other half (src/vda5050_amr/) speaks only MQTT and has no ROS dependency at all.
